lines.text: The wheels on the bus go round and round, all through the town!
Ever wonder how heavy giant bus wheels roll so fast and smooth?
A big bus weighs as much as two whole elephants!
Inside every wheel, hundreds of tiny steel balls roll around an axle!
These ball bearings beat friction so the wheels never get stuck!
The engine turns the axle, and the rubber tires grip the road!
Round and round they glide, keeping all the passengers smiling!
Now you know the engineering secret behind The Wheels on the Bus!
